name: attest-artifact-verifier
title: attest — verify agent artifacts before you trust them
description: HTTP + MCP service: checks a foreign artifact (schema, emptiness, prompt injection, provenance) before an agent acts on it. Four layers, deny-by-default, x402 payments on Base. Runs as a standby web server.
